claim: A player without a diving suit has ten seconds of air under water: the timer is reset to 1,200 (kTicRate*10) whenever he is not under water and loses 4 tics each 30 Hz game frame under it; at 0 he starts to choke and take damage. A diving suit carried in the pack is put on by itself when under 1,080 remain.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/player.cpp:2200-2202 underwaterTime = 1200 when not under water; actor.cpp:5830 minus kTicsPerFrame; actor.cpp:5831-5832 the pack's diving suit; actor.cpp:5833 choking at 0; actor.cpp:5828 keeps it full with the suit on; common_game.h:82-84 kTicRate 120, kTicsPerFrame 4
use: Keep a dive between two airs under ten seconds at a walk (less if the way is not obvious), or put a diving suit before it.
